summary.text: John Velis is a Democratic state senator representing the Hampden and Hampshire District, in office since 2020, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
A lawyer and U.S. Army veteran, he previously served in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2014 to 2020.

paragraphs.text: John Velis was born and lives in Westfield, Massachusetts.
He served in the U.S. Army, the U.S. Army Reserve, and the Massachusetts Army National Guard.
He earned an undergraduate degree in political science from the University of South Florida and a juris doctor from Suffolk University, and his career experience includes working as a lawyer.
Velis represented the 4th Hampden District in the Massachusetts House of Representatives from 2014 to 2020 and has served in the State Senate since 2020.
In the 2025-2026 session he chaired the Joint Committee on Mental Health, Substance Use and Recovery and the Joint Committee on Veterans and Federal Affairs.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on September 1, 2026.
